name: mcp-arcade-cabinets
description: The arcade: games made from what MCP servers said on the wire. Cabinets read mcp-arcade tapes and never touch the score. Ghost on the Menu (shipped), Vibe Typer (in build).

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:play ghost --fixture naive-ndjson && pnpm test:play vibe-typer --tier 0 --bot typist:40
scripts.build:launcher: pnpm run build:launcher:ghost && pnpm run build:launcher:vibe
scripts.build:launcher:ghost: pnpm -F @mcp-arcade-cabinets/cabinet-server build && cross-env VITE_LOCAL_SEATS=true VITE_CABINET=ghost pnpm -F @mcp-arcade-cabinets/cabinets build && pnpm -F @mcptoolshop/ghost-on-the-menu pack:dist
scripts.build:launcher:vibe: pnpm -F @mcp-arcade-cabinets/cabinet-server build && cross-env VITE_LOCAL_SEATS=true VITE_CABINET=vibe pnpm -F @mcp-arcade-cabinets/cabinets build && pnpm -F @mcptoolshop/vibe-typer pack:dist
